newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says buys 468T of Australian frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says buys 468T of Australian frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) said on Wednesday it bought 468 tonnes of Australian frozen beef on Tuesday.
An LPMO official said the beef purchase was passed on September 13 due to high prices.
He did not give further details.

Last Friday the LPMO held tenders for 9,613 tonnes of frozen beef and bought 9,145 tonnes. The Friday purchase breaks down into 6,030 tonnes of Australian grass-fed fullsets, 276 tonnes of New Zealand grass-fed beef, 2,605 tonnes of U.S. chuck roll and 234 tonnes of Canadian chuck roll.
